  /init - create an AGENTS.md file with instructions for Codex
  /status - show current session configuration
  /permissions - choose what Codex is allowed to do
  /model - choose what model and reasoning effort to use
  /review - review any changes and find issues


› Without running any commands or tools, write a 30-line poem about terminal multiplexers.


• The terminal unfolds its little rooms,
  Each pane a lamp against the sleeping street.
  In one, a patient compilation blooms;
  In one, the logs repeat their restless beat.
  A cursor keeps the watch beside my tea,
  While distant servers whisper through the wire.
  I split the dark and make a space for three:
  A shell, a test, a small consuming fire.
  The borders shift like walls inside a dream;
  My crowded desk acquires another wing.
  Along the bottom runs a quiet seam
  Of names for every half-completed thing.
  Control and prefix turn a hidden key;
  A window rises, numbered, into view.
  The others hold their places patiently,
  With work I meant to finish passing through.
  Then somewhere, rain dismantles my connection.
  The laptop shuts; the kitchen clock strikes two.
  My session carries on without direction,
  Its stubborn processes still pushing through.
  By morning I return across the ocean
  Of routers blinking underneath the day.
  Reattached, I find the same commotion:
  The test has failed in an instructive way.
  Scrollback preserves the hours I was missing;
  A warning waits above a hundred lines.
  Outside, the kettle has begun its hissing;
  Inside, another careful fix aligns.
  I leave one pane for work I cannot name,
  And all these little rooms retain their flame.

  Worked for 7s • 5:06 PM
